race.comment: EGMONT (6) is the horse to beat after two solid Eagle Farm runs in stronger company. Should find this a touch easier and still has plenty of scope for improvement. SAXON SPIRIT (9) brings Saturday BM70 form, having placed at Doomben first-up, and her Listed Show A Heart run last campaign adds depth to her profile. DUCHESS DIFFICULT (4) got off the mark comprehensively two back before being too bad to be true last time. Willing to have another look. THE EPIC JOURNEY (10) made an immediate impact when getting off the mark on debut at Lismore. Has been kept fresh for this and is drawn to get all the favours. Not understimating.
